fields.name: resultArtifact
fields.role: raw callback result used for audit and later reruns

fields.name: targetItem
fields.role: null means full run; an integer means targeted rerun

invariants.rule: moving the target item after the source run counts as a source change
a replayed success callback preserves the existing inference and repairs only missing artifacts
callback output IDs must exactly match the target item IDs
a changed current revision rejects the apply
